test_cases.title: Saving an empty customer form shows each required message
acs: DERIVED: Client validators on Contracts Admin/Customer.aspx block an empty save and show 13 message(s) (survey 2026-11-02)
assumptions: The customer form is Contracts Admin/Customer.aspx opened without parameters.
13 validation messages are expected, one per Examples row.
The empty save is blocked by the client validators, so nothing is saved.
Representative sample: one row stands for the 13 similar rows; the full list is kept in docs/full-examples/ and can be restored.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/Customer.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
steps.expected: The form loads with empty fields.
The page stays on the form and nothing is saved.
Each message of the Examples table is shown.

steps.action: Check for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.
